name: Access design tools from the toolbar – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Move tools. When you open a design file, the Move tool is enabled by default. Open the Move tools menu to access the Hand and Scale tools:.

name: Use Figma products with a keyboard – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Enable the desired tool using its keyboard shortcut, the actions menu, or press F6 (Mac) or Ctrl F6 (Windows) until the toolbar is focused, then use the arrow ...

name: Shape tools – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Hold down Option / Alt to create and resize shapes from their center. Hold down Shift and Option / Alt at the same time to do both actions.

name: Crop an image – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: To crop your image into a circle or ellipse shape, you can either increase the layer's corner radius, use the image as a layer fill, or create a mask.

name: Scale layers while maintaining proportions - Figma Learn
snippet: To resize an object using the scale tool: Activate the scale tool by pressing K , or by clicking in the toolbar and selecting Scale. Select an object ...

name: Select keyboard layout – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Figma's default keyboard shortcuts are based on the layout of a US QWERTY keyboard. Select the tab for your keyboard layout to view the updated shortcuts. ...
